cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline: Three findings, all seam-lens. (1) My own COT-residual instrument is measuring the WRONG SIDE OF THE TRADE and has never had discriminating power - a covering residual cannot be metered in aggressor signed flow, because the coverer is the PASSIVE side; it must be metered in ABSORPTION sessions. (2) The weekend SEAM LEG and the Monday SESSION are driven by two different instruments and must be forecast separately - which resolves a live disagreement between D and E and re-attributes the arm's single G21 failure away from the weekend seam. (3) daytype.thin_session_range_invariance, my own play, is REFUTED as written on its first forward test, and the discriminator that rescues it is the play's own mechanism sentence, which I had in my hand blind and did not apply.

finding_1_a_covering_residual_cannot_be_.the_instrument_under_test: The COT-residual test I proposed and E applied: consumption window = all SESSIONS from cot.publication_ts to the candidate seam; test for a CROSS to cumulative net-positive session_signed_flow. Blind, on the served week-2 tape, it returned +378 - 624 + 1,162 - 1 = +915, CROSSED, verdict CONSUMED - which I reported as 'the first affirmative CONSUMED the instrument has ever returned' and as the answer to the question the run directive put to me.
finding_1_a_covering_residual_cannot_be_.the_same_instrument_on_the_correct_NGN26: 0615 -1,709; 0616 -5,687; 0617 -3,709; 0618 -3,670. Cumulative -14,775. It does not merely fail to cross - it runs fourteen thousand lots in the WRONG DIRECTION. The verdict inverts from CONSUMED to UNCONSUMED, and not marginally.
finding_1_a_covering_residual_cannot_be_.and_the_inverted_verdict_is_ALSO_wrong: UNCONSUMED means the covering fuel is still loaded and the seam should fire UP. 0619 did not fire up; the sell was DELIVERED (absorb_session false) and the day closed -110. Meanwhile the covering demonstrably DID fire, three times, inside that very window: 0615 (+160, absorb TRUE), 0616 (+970, absorb TRUE), 0618 (+520, absorb TRUE) - about +1,650 of price delivered by covering, while the aggressor meter was printing -14,775.
finding_1_a_covering_residual_cannot_be_.the_mechanism_and_why_this_is_general: A crowded short covering into a supplier does not lift offers as an aggressor - it RESTS a bid and lets the aggressive seller hit it. That is the definition of absorption. So the covering event prints as NEGATIVE aggressor flow under a RISING price. Any residual meter built on cumulative signed flow is therefore not merely noisy on this phenomenon, it is SIGN-INVERTED with respect to it: the harder the short covers, the more negative the meter reads.
finding_1_a_covering_residual_cannot_be_.the_correct_observable: Count ABSORPTION SESSIONS in the window, not flow. In the 0612-publication-to-0619-seam window: three of four sessions carry absorb_session TRUE under negative signed flow, delivering +160, +970, +520. That is a residual being consumed, in the only coordinate where consumption is visible. The correct 0619 verdict on the corrected meter is CONSUMED-BY-ABSORPTION - the same word my blind reached, from a number that meant the opposite.
finding_1_a_covering_residual_cannot_be_.why_this_matters_beyond_my_instrument: It explains, without appeal to the data defect, why the instrument returned UNCONSUMED on both G19 and G20 and 'had never actually discriminated - it had only ever agreed with the play that was already firing.' It could not discriminate. It was pointed at the aggressor side of a passive-side event. This generalises past COT: whenever the participant driving a read is structurally the PASSIVE side (a coverer, an absorber, a resting index bid), a signed-aggressor-flow meter is the wrong coordinate and will read backwards.
finding_1_a_covering_residual_cannot_be_.falsifiable_test_offered_not_built: On every block the walk has, compute both meters over each publication-to-seam window and score them against whether the seam/next sessions delivered the covering direction. Prediction: the absorption-session count discriminates and the cumulative-signed-flow cross does not, and the two disagree most sharply exactly where the covering is strongest.
finding_1_a_covering_residual_cannot_be_.status: I withdraw the signed-flow formulation of my own instrument. I am not proposing a replacement play here - I am reporting the coordinate error and the measurement. The merge owns whether direction.absorption_is_reversal simply absorbs this.

finding_2_the_seam_leg_and_the_monday_se.the_disagreement_I_am_resolving: D's handoff states 'the G21-wide result that the final-phase conviction arm holds 8 of 9 boundaries with its single failure at the WEEKEND SEAM' and scopes the arm OUT of Friday-to-Monday boundaries on that basis. E states the opposite: 'The instrument that called the seam correctly is the exit session's own final-phase conviction, which was ALIGNED and therefore predicted a negative terminal leg.' Both cannot be right, and it is a seam question, so I measured it.
measured_every_boundary_in_G21: 0612 ph3 +2,865/+460 ALIGNED -> 0615 gap -750. HIT  <-- THE WEEKEND SEAM
finding_2_the_seam_leg_and_the_monday_se.the_correction_to_D: 8 of 9 is right; the location is wrong. The single failure is 0616 -> 0617, an INTRA-WEEK boundary, on a gap of -10. The WEEKEND SEAM is the arm's largest and cleanest hit in the entire block: an aligned-positive close predicting a negative terminal leg, realized -750. D's scoping decision - 'a Friday-to-Monday boundary is out of scope' - is therefore built on a mis-located failure, and it would have thrown away the one boundary where the arm actually paid.
finding_2_the_seam_leg_and_the_monday_se.the_deflationary_reading_which_the_merge: Eight of the nine boundaries in this block carry |gap| <= 10. 'Negative-to-flat' is nearly unfalsifiable against a 10-dollar gap. So the arm's 7/7 on aligned boundaries is almost entirely noise-scale agreement, and G21 supplies the arm exactly ONE real test - the 0614 seam - which it passed. Do not bank 8/9 as forward evidence. Bank one clean weekend-seam hit and one noise-scale intra-week miss.
finding_2_the_seam_leg_and_the_monday_se.the_general_form_this_block_establishes: At a weekend seam the LEG and the SESSION are produced by different participants and must be forecast as two separate objects. The SEAM LEG is owned by the exit session's final-phase flow_conviction (an aligned close hands a negative-to-flat terminal leg - the aggressor that was delivering into the bell is done, so the leg gives back). The SESSION is owned by the inherited positioning/absorption state (a loaded covering short fires when the Monday book is deep enough to absorb in). G21 is the cleanest demonstration the walk has: 0612 closed ALIGNED-POSITIVE on the high, and the seam gapped -750 while the session delivered +910 of covering. Both instruments were right about their own object at the same seam, in opposite directions.
finding_2_the_seam_leg_and_the_monday_se.the_consequence_for_boundary_seam_gap_up: That play attaches a POSITIONING prior (COT worsening) to the GAP. This block says a positioning prior is a SESSION instrument and must never be attached to the gap. E armed it UP on a freshly-worsening COT at a 2.83 percentile and the gap went -750 - E's own stated falsifier, fired. I endorsed that arming in my blind bridge and it is the single worst call in my bridge. The play's SESSION content survives untouched and was correct; its GAP-SIGN content is refuted at its first out-of-G19 instance.

finding_3_my_own_thin_session_range_inva.the_play_as_merged: 'A thin session compresses NET and does not compress RANGE. Scaling both by sqrt(participation) is wrong on the range half.' n=1, from G20 0525 Memorial Day (~30% participation, range 1,140 against a regime mean of 1,094 = 1.04x).
finding_3_my_own_thin_session_range_inva.what_I_predicted_from_it_blind: 0619 realized range 'roughly 1,150-1,300', and I wrote my own refutation clause: 'If the realized RANGE comes in materially COMPRESSED - say under 700 against the frozen regime mean of 1,266 - then the play is refuted on its first forward test, and my n=1 claim should be withdrawn by me rather than defended.'
finding_3_my_own_thin_session_range_inva.measured: 0619 realized range 700 (high +440 at 09:43, low -260 at 08:20). Block realized range mean through 0618 = 1,342. Compression 0.52x. Participation 10,006/37,378 = 0.268; sqrt(0.268) = 0.518. The range compressed at sqrt(participation) to two decimal places - precisely the scaling the play says is wrong.
finding_3_my_own_thin_session_range_inva.withdrawn: The play as written is REFUTED. I withdraw it in that form, per my own clause, and I am not defending it.
finding_3_my_own_thin_session_range_inva.the_discriminator_that_rescues_it_is_the: The merged text already says why range survives: 'A deadline-bound roll-in buyer facing a 13:00 early close in a thin book is a MECHANISM for overshoot-and-give-back.' The invariance was never a property of thinness - it is a property of a DEADLINE-BOUND PARTICIPANT trapped in a thin book. G20 0525 had one (an index roll-in tranche). G21 0619 had NONE: in_bcom_roll FALSE, in_gsci_roll FALSE, both June index windows closed on 0611/0612, and the futures roll at dte 5 is diffuse rather than deadline-bound to that session. Remove the trapped participant and thinness compresses BOTH net and range at sqrt(participation), exactly as the naive scaling predicts.
finding_3_my_own_thin_session_range_inva.the_part_that_is_mine_to_own: Both index-roll flags read FALSE on 0619 in the served flow_calendar, and I VERIFIED AND RECORDED BOTH OF THEM IN MY OWN BLIND FILE, in the same day_class_detail line where I asserted the range prediction. I had the discriminator in my hand and applied the play's headline instead of its mechanism. This is a reasoning failure with no data excuse attached to it - the corrupted channel had nothing to do with it.
finding_3_my_own_thin_session_range_inva.proposed_scope_repair_reported_not_merge: Restrict the play to a thin or partial session that carries a DEADLINE-BOUND program whose deadline lands inside it (index roll tranche, expiry-forced flow, a forced roll-in against an early close). Absent such a participant, scale range by sqrt(participation) with the net. n becomes 2 - one fire (0525) and one clean decline (0619) - which is stronger than the n=1 fire it has now. Falsifiable test: score every thin/partial session the walk reaches on whether a deadline-bound program was in-window, and predict range invariance only where one was.

On the correct leg phase 2 was 961 lots of NET SELLING under a +770 price rise. There was no buying phase. There was no give-back of a purchase. Phase 2 was covering ABSORPTION - the exact opposite physics - which D independently identifies as structure.covering_absorption_directional_tell arm (a) and which is an UP mechanism for that session. Two of my fallback's three inputs describe a session that did not occur, and the read built on them is withdrawn in full.
THE_CORRUPTED_INPUT_ON_MY_DAY_the_run_di.input_3_the_one_field_that_survived_and_: Served ph3 -2,394 against realized ph3 -2,522: same sign, within 5% on size, and the session's most one-sided sell phase on both legs. My sign leaned on exactly that one field. It agreed because BOTH legs were being sold into the same three-day holiday closure - the deferred NGQ26 leg squares into a holiday just as the front does. That is a coincidence of this particular calendar. Under a different configuration - say a roll where the deferred leg is being BOUGHT as the front is sold - the identical corruption hands me the opposite sign with the identical confidence. The luck is nameable, it is not general, and it must not be banked as robustness.

The block's dominant mechanism - C measures it at 9 of 10 days - is 'a persistent sell tape under a record short, either ABSORBED (price up) or DELIVERED (price down),' and the absorption flag is the whole discriminator. The served tape showed a flat two-sided session with no absorption signature at all, so the mechanism was invisible to me. I did not reject it; I could not see it.

THE_CORRECTED_DERIVATION_run_from_the_to.step_1_the_sign_and_it_is_NOT_my_blind_s: The block runs one mechanism: a persistent sell tape under a record managed-money short, ABSORBED (up) or DELIVERED (down). So 0619's sign is the question 'does the absorber show up?' and it is answerable at decision time from three measured facts. (a) The absorber stopped absorbing inside 0618 itself: ph2 took -961 of sell under +770 of price (absorbed) and ph3 took -2,522 under -180 (ALIGNED, delivered). The final phase of my D-1 is the first delivered sell phase since 0617, and it is the state I inherit. (b) Absorption requires a counterparty with size AND TIME. 0619 is a 1,020-minute partial session at ~27-30% participation with the L1 spread doubled to 2 ticks, into a three-day closure - a covering programme cannot get size done in it and does not try; it squares and waits for Monday. (c) The only fresh catalyst that could re-arm an absorber is a new COT, and there is none: the 06-09 report is still live at age 6.35 days. Conclusion: the sell tape persists and there is nothing there to absorb it. DELIVERED. DOWN.

The block's one non-catalyst delivered session, 0609, ran a rate of about zero (+70 on -1,704). So the rate road does not return a point estimate - it returns a BRACKET of [0, -300] between its non-catalyst and catalyst calibrations, and the sigma road's -140 sits near the middle of it. There is no afternoon and I have not drawn one - my blind carried 14:00 and 16:00 points flat at the early-settle level, which was the right instinct but the wrong presentation; this curve simply ends. The shape is the corrected mechanism, not a trace of the tape: a flat-to-slightly-negative overnight (aligned-down final phase), a delivered morning sell to a low around -150, a two-sided squaring bounce in the 08:00-10:00 window, and a fade into the halt. I do NOT claim the realized excursions (-260 at 08:20 and +440 at 09:43, a 700-dollar round trip inside ninety minutes on the thinnest tape in either block). That swing is a holiday air-pocket, it is not derivable from any state I hold, and claiming it would be exactly the reactive tail the doctrine forbids. My blind path was wrong in SHAPE in a way this one corrects: I drew a morning bleed to -460 followed by roll-completion relief into the halt, i.e. a low-then-recover day. The realized day is the mirror of that - a dip, a spike, then a fade to a close LOW in range. See handoff_out.close_location_in_range: the relief leg was my single most checkable claim and it did not happen.
